relations.subject: cbl:scopes-collections
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: structural cross-reference (this page manages the hierarchy database.md defines)
relations.evidence: Scopes and collections allow you to organize your documents within a database.

relations.subject: cbl:scopes-collections
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: structural cross-reference - collections are the unit indexes are created against

cross_product_finding: No access-control dimension whatsoever: creating, indexing, dropping, and listing scopes/collections are plain client-API operations with no privilege check, no role, and no edition gate mentioned on this page. The only 'rule enforcement' described is structural/naming validation (character sets, length limits, uniqueness within scope) rather than an authorization decision - a useful contrast with server/'s privilege-gated bucket/scope/collection management (e.g. a presumed 'manage-scopes' style privilege on the server side) which has no counterpart in CBL, since collections here are purely local, developer-controlled containers with no multi-tenant or multi-user contention to arbitrate.
